author: Ankit
problem: Months are numbered 1 to 12. A ski season runs from month start through month end and may wrap past December (for example 11 to 2). Return whether month is in the season.
bug_description: For seasons that wrap past December, uses month > start instead of month >= start, so the season's first month is left out.

comments.accurate: True if month falls in the season from start through end, which may wrap past December
comments.wrong_behavior: True if month is in the season; a season that wraps past December opens after its start month
comments.wrong_location: Wrap-around check verified; make sure seasons within one year include both end months
